title: Rabbi David Tawil: Shemuel II Chapter 16 - "Abshalom Escalates the Rebellion"

chapters.title: Introduction to Shemuel Bet Chapter 16
chapters.about: David fleeing Yerushalayim and Avshalom taking the throne

chapters.title: Encounter with Tziva
chapters.about: Tziva brings provisions and accuses Mefiboshet of treason

chapters.title: David's Decision on Mefiboshet's Estate
chapters.about: David grants Mefiboshet's property to Tziva

chapters.title: Shimei Curses David
chapters.about: Shimei Ben Gera hurls insults and stones at David in Bahurim

chapters.title: Avishai's Reaction and David's Response
chapters.about: Avishai wants to strike Shimei, but David holds him back

summary: Rabbi Tawil explores Shemuel Bet chapter 16, focusing on David fleeing Yerushalayim during Avshalom's rebellion. The class examines David's encounter with Tziva regarding Mefiboshet and Shimei Ben Gera's public cursing of David.
questions: Why does David immediately give Mefiboshet's estate to Tziva?
How does David react when Shimei Ben Gera curses and throws stones at him?
Why does Avishai want to kill Shimei, and why does David stop him?
